noah: Following the cache-hotkey postmortem: we need a concise triage section in the runbook plus clear action owners. Sketch below, please claim items and ETA.

emma: paste sketch pls

noah: Triage sketch to add to cookbook:
- Quick checks: PromQL for cache evictions, redis INFO memory, and top key heatmap.
- Short mitigations: apply prefix-based TTLs, set read-only mode for nonessential traffic, scale read replicas.
- Rollout: canary TTL change (5% traffic, 30m), monitor evictions/latency, rollback on >10% evictions or p95 latency regress >200ms vs baseline.
- Postmortem follow-up: add synthetic test to CI that simulates hotkey and validates eviction thresholds.

noah: Commands/snippets to include in cookbook (copy verbatim):
```bash
# promql: evictions per minute
sum(rate(redis_evicted_keys_total[1m]))
# redis mem and evictions
redis-cli INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|evicted_keys"
# top keys heat (approx, using scan + memory usage)
redis-cli --scan | xargs -n1 -P8 redis-cli MEMORY USAGE | awk '{print $2, $1}' | sort -nr | head -n 30
# k8s pod checks for cache tier
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=cache -o wide; kubectl logs <pod> --since=1h | tail -n 200
```

chris: I can own the CI synthetic test and add a load job we can run in staging. ETA Tue.

emma: I'll open the cookbook PR and add the PromQL snippets and the canary step. ETA Mon EOD.

zara: For escalation, propose explicit matrix:
- Severity P1: page oncall + infra lead, auto-create ticket.
- Condition to escalate: evicted_keys > 0 AND p95 latency > 250ms for 5m.
I'll add Slack templates and oncall rotation contacts. ETA Wed.

noah: Good. Also add an automation item: when a cookbook change merges, post a follow-up reminder to the postmortem board and tag action owners. ops-bot can create and assign if we give it the ticket fields.

ops-bot: Automation note: I can file follow-up card in the postmortem tracker. Reply with: "file: <short title> | owner: <name> | due: <YYYY-MM-DD>" to trigger.

chris: Filing for test: file: add-staging-hotkey-test | owner: chris | due: 2026-03-27
